Players Committee card image of [[Death Star Reactor Terminal]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. X = number of your devices on table. Once during your turn, may peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand, or ▼ (or deploy from Lost Pile) a device (except Restraining Bolt or Tractor Beam). [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/deathstarreactorterminal.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/deathstarreactorterminal.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
